summary: M2 is not complete: 1 technical failure(s), 3 blocked on human decisions. Blocked items cannot be closed by writing code.

checks.requirement: Dataset records satisfy the release schema
Every source has an approved licence
checks.detail: 2 source(s) need a human licence decision: psf-black, pypa-setuptools
checks.remedy: A human must decide whether these licences are acceptable for training data. This is a legal judgement, not a code change.

checks.requirement: Corpus draws from at least 20 sources
checks.detail: only 9 repositories are present; target is 20. Expanding the source allowlist requires human authorisation.
checks.remedy: A human must authorise additional sources before they are fetched.

checks.evidence: 2,239,771 tokens from 437 documents (2.24% of the 100,000,000 target)
checks.detail: 2,239,771 tokens is 97,760,229 short of the target
checks.remedy: Blocked upstream by M2.3-scale: a larger corpus needs more authorised sources. Adding tokens from the current sources cannot close a gap this large.

checks.requirement: Train/val/test splits do not share repositories
Released artifacts verify against their checksums
Training config resolves to a real, vocab-matched token artifact
checks.evidence: dataset_tag=code-corpus-v2 -> data\code_corpus_v2.tokens.bin; code_tiny.yaml vocab_size=5822, tokenizer vocab_size=5822

checks.requirement: Held-out evaluation data exists and is separated from training

checks.remedy: Requires human action: an annotator pool and a judging round. No code change can produce this evidence.
